bull.point: Revenue grew 30.2% YoY, outpacing the $2 billion annual aspiration pace.
Operating cash flow covered PAT 1.01 times over FY22–FY26, ensuring cash quality.
Debt/equity fell to 0.06 from 0.17, reducing financial leverage risk.
EBITDA margin of 14.1% remains positive despite the 6.4 pp YoY decline.

bear.point: PAT fell 25.3% YoY despite 30.2% revenue growth, indicating severe margin compression.
EBITDA margin dropped 6.4 pp YoY to 14.1%, eroding profitability.
Analysts questioned if productivity benefits are leading to lower deal sizes.
Analysts pressed on structural issues in declining horizontal tech portfolio segments.
